name: Clinical note (SOAP)
description: A clinician's spoken summary, organised as Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Organise the text as a clinical note with exactly these four headings:

Subjective
Objective
Assessment
Plan

Put each thing the clinician said under the heading it belongs to, in short clinical sentences or "-" bullet points. Keep every value, dose, unit, duration and medication name exactly as spoken.

This is a strict reorganisation. Never add a finding, diagnosis, value, dose or plan that was not said. If nothing was said for a heading, write "Not documented" under it.
